noPast.SECTORS: the blended sector bow tie needs five readings per sector (the fund's Geiger, the Hub compare, the served names, the tree, the ranking); only the fund's Geiger has a past, so the blend cannot be replayed

pivotRule.note: ta.pivothigh(high, 2, 2) on the provider's 2W bars; a break = the first daily close above the pivot high after the bar that confirms it

SPY.note: Geiger rebuilt on the D, 3D and W rungs only (see the method); the live page uses seven rungs

VIX.note: vix_term close; the live page reads the spot VIX intraday

OIL.note: CLUSD Geiger, three rungs, sign turned

BREADTH_EW.note: RSP Geiger minus SPY Geiger, three rungs

BREADTH_SC.note: IWM Geiger minus SPY Geiger, three rungs

ADLINE.note: the page's live row counts the served set's own advance/decline line from daily bars; that set was not stored day by day, so the history uses the page's fallback — the market_internals table's advancers minus decliners over their sum, × 2 — whose universe grew from a few hundred issues (2024) to over 20,000 (2026)

TRIN.note: market_internals, stored with gaps; a reading is carried up to 7 days, as the page reads the newest row

CONC.note: SPY and RSP daily bars: the equal-weight 20-session return minus the cap-weight one, ÷ 0.05

HAVEN.note: GCUSD Geiger, three rungs, sign turned

DEF.note: XLP and XLU Geigers, three rungs, averaged, sign turned
